mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE >5.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction signal (FEDFUNDS up + CPIAUCSL up) fails to predict negative returns in >40% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth does not produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC for RSAFS in this regime is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in >60% of expansionary periods, or Rank IC for GDPC1 is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO <100.0 for 2 months fails to predict negative returns in >40% of instances, or Rank IC for INDPRO threshold signal is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls >5% and INDPRO falls >2% in 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction signal (HOUST down + INDPRO down) fails to predict negative returns in >40% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the labor market recovery regime (UNRATE < 5.0% for 3 months), a declining unemployment rate signals strengthening job conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of labor market recovery periods, or Rank IC for UNRATE in this regime is <0.03.
